protocol.matching: same queries across codecs, chunks and modes for non-crossing groups; cross_chunk depends on block size
protocol.order: configurations/rounds/modes interleaved and shuffled per session; query categories shuffled per round
protocol.cache: full archive pre-read before each trial; OS warm cache, fresh Python worker per mode/round
protocol.timing: request total; separate open/read/close spans; truth reads and byte comparison excluded; worker startup excluded
protocol.summary: median and range of per-round nearest-rank p95, not a confidence interval or pooled p95
protocol.storage: same RKV v2 container, dedup on, transform none; raw/Zlib 6/Zstd 3
protocol.work: analytical touched raw/stored payload bytes, not physical disk IO

limits: sessions are consecutive within one campaign
no OS cache eviction; warm results cannot predict cold disk latency
query-level dependencies and only a few rounds; no statistical significance claim
decoder RSS includes prepared truth bytes and runtime; not comparable to v0.2 restore RSS
